_comment: Pass/fail thresholds for parity/results/metrics.json, checked by compare.py. A rule's path may use '*' for any key; a rule that matches no metric is a violation unless it is 'optional' (for datasets that may be skipped). 'why' explains each bound.

rules.why: arcsinh equals flowCore up to f32 output rounding
logicle equals flowCore on its 0..M output scale
FlowKit's Gating-ML logicle is the same curve on a 0..1 scale: compare up to an affine map
hyperlog equals flowCore and FlowKit
biexponential equals flowjo_biexp with the AutoSpill parameters (the 4096-channel reference uses different parameters on purpose)
spillover matrix equals autospill to round-off
reference spectra match the truth
unmixing equals upstream OLS on the same spectra
PeacoQC masks equal R PeacoQC in every mode
separated populations: R reaches 0.9997 seed to seed
overlapping populations: R's own seed-to-seed minimum is 0.93; no bit-exact RNG
CytoScan features equal R on the full-sample dataset
isolation-forest outlier flags agree with R; subsampled cohorts differ by at most one file in twenty
regression floor: the novelty detector finds the injected anomalous files (lowest today: cytoscan_ref100 fingerprint, 4 of 5)
regression floor at today's level: Rust falls back to a diagonal Gaussian where mclust picks a constrained model (parity/REPORT.md section 3); raising it needs the constrained models
every gate count equals FlowKit
FCS written by cytiq opens in flowio/FlowKit without ignoring offset discrepancies
compensation equals flowCore::compensate up to f32 storage
compensate then transform equals flowCore up to f32 storage
the margin mask flags exactly the events at the detector limit $PnR - 1
the detector limit is PeacoQC::RemoveMargins' upper threshold or above it, so RemoveMargins removes every flagged event (and more: the observed extremes and values at or below flowCore's -111 floor)
every saturated event is found
PeacoQC inside the chain equals R PeacoQC on the same transformed values
the unstable interval is removed
clean masks equal FlowKit evaluating the exported gates
debris, doublets and dead cells are found
almost no artefact survives the combined mask
the combined mask keeps the good events
gating the compensated, transformed file equals FlowKit gating the raw file with the strategy
population gates match the truth, the rare one included
population gates match the truth, the rare one included
FlowSOM recovers the true populations
FlowSOM agrees with R FlowSOM on the same events
